entries.title: Audit Logs
entries.description: These endpoints are served by aster-api (the policy engine) and cover policy execution events that are SHA-256 hash-chained.

entries.description: Inspect how a specific policy version has been used in production: which workflows invoked it, when evaluations occurred, the impact of rolling it back,…

entries.title: GraphQL Mutations
entries.description: Mutations are write operations that create, update, or delete resources. All mutations must be sent as POST /graphql.

entries.title: GraphQL API Overview
entries.description: The Aster Policy Engine exposes a GraphQL API for querying and managing policies.

entries.title: GraphQL Queries
entries.description: All queries are read-only operations sent as POST /graphql. Queries require HMAC request signing and an X-Tenant-Id header.

entries.title: Batch Evaluate Policies
entries.description: Evaluate up to 100 policy calls in a single HTTP request. Each item in the batch is an independent evaluation request.

entries.title: Clear Policy Cache
entries.description: Invalidate cached policy state held by the engine. The engine caches compiled policy representations for performance.
headings: Clear Cache for a Specific Module
Clear Cache for a Specific Function

entries.title: Evaluate Policy
entries.description: Evaluate a deployed policy by module and function name. The policy must already be deployed to the engine before it can be called through this endpoint.

entries.title: Evaluate Core IR JSON Policy
entries.description: Evaluate a policy expressed as a Core IR JSON object directly, without CNL parsing or compilation.

entries.title: Evaluate Policy from Source
entries.description: Compile and evaluate a CNL (Controlled Natural Language) policy source string on the fly, without requiring the policy to be deployed first.

entries.title: Rollback Policy to Version
entries.description: Revert a policy to a previously saved version. The engine atomically swaps the active version so that subsequent evaluation requests immediately use the…

entries.title: Extract Policy Parameter Schema
entries.description: Parse a CNL source string and return the parameter schema for the specified function.

entries.title: Validate Policy Exists
entries.description: Check whether a policy identified by module and function name is deployed and callable.

entries.title: Get Policy Version History
entries.description: Retrieve the full version history for a policy identified by its internal policy ID.

entries.title: WebSocket Preview Endpoint
entries.description: The preview WebSocket endpoint allows developers to evaluate CNL policy source in real time without deploying it to the engine.

entries.title: Workflow Events
entries.description: Retrieve the ordered sequence of events that make up a workflow's execution history.
